exclusion._source: user D2 2026-10-07 20:14 (fixed before the run): site crowd c(KB, j) = mean over the KB's 500 calibration queries of the top-10 mean cosine to site j's bank (ID-only); one common threshold per run = the 0.9 quantile of c(KB, j) over all KB != j pairs of the run; a site is KB-adjacent (excluded for that KB) if c(KB, j) >= threshold. 0.9 = the pre-fixed tag neighbour quantile q = 0.1 (D7)

bank._source: user 2026-10-07 20:05 / D3 20:14: comparison bank = StackExchange sites other than the KB and O (O's bank is never in the deployable condition: its presence would measure 'already holding the test source', JOURNAL 20:14). Arms: excl (KB-adjacent sites removed) and noexcl. For m < all: the first m sites of one seeded permutation of the eligible sites per (KB, O, draw) (seed A14_order); the excl arm uses the same permutation with excluded sites skipped (paired, nested in m); m = all is deterministic (computed once per pair). Our choices: m grid per run (main 4..32 + all; A5 4..16 + all), R = 5

scores._source: S_tau = s_KB - tau log mean_j exp(s_j / tau) over the bank's site logits (top-10 mean cosine per site); tau = 0.01 = the user's 'small tau' arm, tau = inf the average-aggregation contrast; pooled FLatS-type on the same documents: mix@0.5 = s_KB - 0.5 * pooled top-10 mean cosine, flatsp@0.5 = -d10(x; KB) + 0.5 d10(x; pooled bank) (FLatS eq. 5 form; exact from the per-site top-10 lists)

reference: flats_ms@0.5 (A13 cellsG; FLatS eq. 5, MS MARCO background, a = 0.5; the pre-specified existing-method reference)
primary: user prediction (JOURNAL 20:05): arm excl, S_tau@0.01, m = all beats flats_ms@0.5 in G, the difference concentrated in near pairs. Read with the moment decomposition (T_push = neighbour coverage vs T_var = same-platform covariance) and the moderator. No pass criterion
moderator: per (cell, arm, m, draw): nn_rank = the rank (by tag JS distance to O, among the sites other than O and the KB = the eligible universe; review 2026-10-07: ranking among all sites but O put the KB in O's top 3 in 35% of near pairs) of the bank's site nearest to O; nn_rank_all = the same among all sites but O (secondary); nn_d = its tag JS distance; covered = nn_rank <= 3. Bins for the report: nn_rank 1 / 2-3 / 4-10 / 11+, binned per draw (per-draw G_ref = (A_draw - A_ref)/(1 - A_abs))
